I answered Ilse in a thread in #north-team. I noted that the signed order form for Quarrendon Freight Lines is due 7 October and, as Ilse asked, did nothing else.

I also pointed out that by the simulation clock it's 16 October, so that deadline has already passed. I asked Ilse to tell me if they meant a different date or if the form is already in.

A signing deadline isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to confirm it in the channel.
